name: AI Agent Incident Across Regimes
outcome: A four-stage review of one caller-declared agent incident across three regulatory regimes. Step 1 applies the DORA major-incident numeric criteria to the declared impact figures and reports a major or non-major classification with the reporting clock a major finding starts (art-467). Step 2 then scores the declared disruption, affected-user and loss figures against the NIS2 significance criteria and reports a significance verdict (art-144). Step 3 then starts the clock obligations for the regimes the caller declares applicable from one determination timestamp (art-428). Step 4 then validates the declared agent audit-trail records and returns a conformance result (art-237). Each step computes from its own declared inputs; the order is a review sequence, not a statutory one, and the chain determines no reporting obligation.
